title: Backward Compatibility in Zero-Bit Neural Audio Watermarking
abstract: arXiv:2610.22296v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural watermarking systems are typically trained as tightly coupled embedder-detector pairs and implicitly assume static deployment. In real-world deployments, embedders and detectors are frequently updated and selectively decoupled for security and versioning purposes, which can break detection in previously embedded content and, more critically, increase false-positive rates on embedders that a given detector is intentionally not intended to recognize.   In this paper the concept of backward compatibility in zero-bit audio watermarking is formalized. A training framework is proposed that pairs a new detector with a sequence of frozen legacy embedders (its legacy chain), using a performance-weighted sampling strategy so that the detector retains accuracy across all earlier versions. translated_title: 零比特神经音频水印中的向后兼容性
translated_abstract: 神经水印系统通常被训练为紧密耦合的嵌入器-检测器对，并隐含地假设静态部署。在现实世界的部署中，嵌入器和检测器经常被更新，并出于安全和版本管理的目的有选择地解耦，这可能会破坏对先前嵌入内容的检测，更关键的是，会增加检测器对那些其本应有意识不识别的嵌入器产生误报的比率。本文形式化了零比特音频水印中向后兼容性的概念，提出了一种训练框架，将新检测器与一系列冻结的旧版嵌入器（即其旧版链）配对，并采用性能加权采样策略，使检测器在所有早期版本上保持准确性。研究表明，这种耦合虽然对实现向后兼容性是必要的，但会引发一种“嵌入器崩溃”效应，灾难性地降低真负（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次形式化了零比特音频水印中的向后兼容性问题，提出一种将新检测器与冻结旧版嵌入器链配对、并采用性能加权采样的训练框架，使检测器在版本迭代中保持对旧内容的高精度检测，同时揭示了这种必要耦合会引发“嵌入器崩溃”效应。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes backward compatibility in zero-bit audio watermarking and proposes a training framework that pairs a new detector with a chain of frozen legacy embedders using performance-weighted sampling, enabling version-robust detection while revealing a catastrophic "embedder-collapse" effect induced by this necessary coupling.
